transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

...I guess they brought me in. From work. At the warehouse. 

They said I was... doing things. Like freezing. By the forklift, with my arms up. Or copying the beeping sounds. And the hand signals. I was just... moving boxes in these little patterns. Everyone kept yelling at me to stop, but... yeah. They sent me here.
When you were standing there at the warehouse, were you hearing any voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
...No. Just the normal stuff. The forklift beeping. I don't... I didn't hear voices. Just what was there.
Have you noticed any changes in your memory or your ability to think clearly lately?
...I don't know. I guess my thinking is... fine. I haven't really thought about it. Just... trying to do my job.
Have you experienced any recent head injuries, seizures, or sudden changes in your physical health?
...No. I haven't hit my head. Physical health is... the same. Nothing like that.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being controlled by someone else, or that people around you are talking about you behind your back?
...No. Nobody is... controlling anything. My thoughts are just mine. And I don't really pay attention to what other people talk about. I just... keep to myself mostly.
When you were standing there at the warehouse with your arms up, did you feel like you were physically unable to move or speak, even if you wanted to?
...I don't know. I was just... standing there. I wasn't trying to move. I just... didn't.

When you were copying the beeping sounds or the hand signals at the warehouse, did you feel like you were doing it automatically, almost as if you were mirroring what you saw or heard without being able to stop yourself?

...I don't know about automatic. I guess that's why they brought me in, though. I just... keep doing it. Copying the beeps and the signals. Or I just... freeze up by the forklift with my arms up. Sometimes I move the boxes in these... strange little patterns. Even when everyone is yelling at me to stop, I just... I don't stop. I don't really know why.
Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have a neurological condition, such as epilepsy, or any other chronic medical illness?
...No. No doctor ever said that. I don't... I don't have anything like that. Just... no.
When you find yourself repeating these sounds or freezing in place, do you feel an intense emotional reaction, like fear or anger, or do you feel emotionally detached?
...I don't really feel much of anything. Just... detached, I guess. I'm not scared or mad. I'm just... there.
Have you ever experienced long periods of time where you felt unusually depressed, hopeless, or conversely, unusually energetic and euphoric, to the point where it affected your life?
...No. I haven't. Just... normal, I guess. I don't get like that.
Have you ever had any periods in your life, even years ago, where you acted or felt similarly to how you are acting now?
...No. I don't think so. Never really... been like this before. Just... I don't know. Just now.
When you are not repeating these sounds or freezing in place, do you find that your speech is sometimes disorganized or hard for others to follow?

...Yeah, sometimes. Like at work. The supervisor asks which pallets are going on the truck, and... I try to explain. But my words just... they jump around. From the load sheet to... my old house. Or fishing. Church boxes. ...I don't know. By the time I'm done talking, nobody knows what I meant. So... yeah.
Do you find that you have a hard time getting yourself to do things like showering, getting dressed, or taking care of your basic needs?
...No. I shower. Get dressed. It's... fine. I just do it.
Do you find that you have trouble remembering common things, like where you put your keys, the names of people you know, or how to perform routine tasks at home?
...No. I remember stuff. Keys are... where they go. People's names... I know them. It's not... I don't forget things like that.
When you look back at the past few months, have you noticed any other strange or unusual behaviors starting to happen, even if they were very subtle?
...No. Not really. Just... what I already told you. That's it.
Have you ever felt like your internal thoughts are being broadcasted out loud so that other people can hear what you are thinking?
...No. People can't... hear my thoughts. That's... no. It's just in my head.

Over the past six months or more, have you noticed that you have become less interested in your hobbies, or have you found it harder to maintain your usual level of performance at work or in your social life?

...Yeah, I guess. Work's been... they took me off the forklift. Said I wasn't safe. And my classes at the community college... I'm pretty far behind now. I don't go to the church food bank anymore either. People there... they said they couldn't count on me. So... yeah. Things are harder.

Have you noticed any changes in your physical health, such as unexplained weight changes, unusual fatigue, or changes in your vision or coordination, that started around the same time as these behaviors?
...No. I don't think so. My body is fine. I haven't... noticed anything like that. Just... normal.
Did you start taking any new medications, supplements, or substances, or did you have any major change in your medical treatment, around the time these behaviors first started?
...No. I haven't... I haven't taken anything new. Just... no. Everything's the same.
